load_vllm_model: load a vLLM model using tensorizer weights from a serialized URI with tensor parallel support
save_vllm_model: save a vLLM model to a tensorized format using TensorizerConfig and ModelConfig
load_model_weights: load serialized model weights into an existing nn.Module from tensorizer stream or vLLM-tensorized file
download_model: download and verify a tensorized model from a remote URI using TensorizerConfig stream
validate_config: validate tensorizer configuration dict and reject blacklisted arguments like device, dtype, and mode
